summary: Phase 7 (Privacy) full-stack testing on the public preview URL. NEW suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_privacy.py (23 pytest cases, all PASS) + full regression: 109/109 pass (parallel and serial). (1) CONSENT SCOPE ENFORCEMENT verified end-to-end: provider enrolled QA_ trainee with 'Wage / income data' scope UNCHECKED (consent-checkbox checked) -> Messaging Simulator 'Employed' + '15-25k' -> POST /api/employment returned wage_bracket:null, GET /api/trainees/{id} confirms the persisted employment_record has wage_bracket null, GET /wage-progression returns wage_consent:false with points:[]; UI shows wage-consent-off ('Wage-sharing consent is off - no income data is collected or shown for this trainee.') and consent-scopes chips contain only 'Employment status' + 'Contact for verification'. CONTRAST trainee with wage_data consent: wage_bracket '15-25k' stored, employment card shows '. Rs15-25k', wage_consent true, no wage-consent-off. Admin CSV shows '(consent off)' (6 seeded rows + QA row). compute_summary wage aggregation is restricted to wage-consented trainees (sum(wage_distribution) <= placed records). (2) REVOKE & ANONYMIZE (real DB op) verified on a QA_ trainee via UI button revoke-consent-btn + confirm dialog: full_name -> 'Anonymized Trainee #f81a', phone_masked -> 'REDACTED', consent.given false / scope [], anonymized:true, anonymized-badge rendered, revoke button disappears, scopes chip area shows 'None - no data may be collected for this trainee'. Verified via GET (DB truly changed, phone_number omitted), provider aggregate total_trainees unchanged, trainee still present in admin CSV/aggregates, consent_log row action=revoked with anonymized:true; 2nd revoke -> 409, unknown id -> 404, unauthenticated -> 403. (3) ADMIN AGGREGATION-ONLY: GET /api/trainees and /api/trainees-overview return 403 for super_admin AND state_admin without a drill-down; 200 with ?provider_id= or ?district=; provider sees only its own trainees (cross-provider provider_id returns only the intersection with its own set - verified no foreign ids leak; 1 overlapping trainee is legitimately enrolled with 2 providers); district_admin overview limited to one district; /api/analytics/overview for all 4 roles returns aggregates only (no full_name/phone_masked keys anywhere in payload); admin dashboard UI renders 12 recharts surfaces, KPIs, district ranking and provider list with ZERO trainee-level PII table and 0 console errors; CSV (152 rows) + PDF (%PDF) exports work. (4) AUDIT TRAIL: consent-audit-trail renders consent-log-N entries with correct labels (Consent Granted / Data Accessed / Consent Revoked & Anonymized) + date + 'by <email>'; GET /api/trainees/{id} writes an 'accessed' row every time (confirmed: 1 granted row on enroll -> 2 rows after one profile open; 7 rows after the UI flow; 9 after revoke) and shows up after reload; PATCH consent produces granted/scope_updated/revoked in order; logs sorted ascending. (5) Regression: provider enroll flow, wage-progression dedup/non-decreasing, exports, dashboards, ML routes, auth/lockout all pass. DB left clean: 150 trainees, 0 QA_/Anonymized rows, login_attempts cleared (consent_logs grew to 241 from 'accessed' rows - by design).

critical.issue: Only the 'wage_data' scope is enforced. With consent fully REVOKED/anonymized (consent.given=false, scope=[]) POST /api/employment still returns 200 and creates a NEW employment record for that trainee (verified on the anonymized QA trainee: {'type':'employed','employer_name':'Post-revoke Corp'} accepted, wage nulled). /followups/schedule also schedules new check-ins without excluding revoked/anonymized trainees. Expected: 403 (or skip) when consent.given is false or 'employment_status'/'contact_for_verification' scope is missing - otherwise 'revoke' does not actually stop data collection.

minor.issue: Every profile/simulator load writes an 'accessed' consent_log row (by design) with no throttling - one manual QA session produced 6 'Data Accessed' rows for a single trainee and the audit trail is dominated by them. Consider de-duplicating per user+trainee within a time window or paging/filtering the trail in the UI.
Items still expose the stringified Mongo `_id` (pre-existing app-wide ser() convention); consider projecting it out or renaming to id.

Anonymization scrubs name/phone/employer_contact/raw_response_text but keeps the previously collected wage_bracket on employment_records. Acceptable (aggregate preservation) but worth documenting in docs/privacy_design.md so reviewers do not read it as a leak.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Simulator' button stays enabled for an anonymized / consent-revoked trainee, so a provider can still walk the WhatsApp flow and record a new employment outcome for someone who withdrew consent. Hide/disable it (with a tooltip) when consent.given is false.

Rows (provider-drill-N) have no onClick/keyboard handler - clicking does nothing. The backend supports the required trainee-level drill-down (?provider_id=) but there is NO admin UI path to it, so the 'admins must drill into a provider to see trainee-level data' story cannot be demonstrated in the UI. District rows (district-row-N) do apply an aggregate filter.

issues: Trail is flooded with repeated 'Data Accessed' rows (one per page load) which visually buries the meaningful granted/scope_updated/revoked events - group or collapse consecutive access events.
React warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration error) from the shared Select component rendering a span inside <option>.

action_items: HIGH: enforce non-wage consent scopes on write paths - POST /employment, /non-placement-reason and follow-up scheduling must 403/skip when consent.given is false or the required scope ('employment_status' / 'contact_for_verification') is absent
HIGH: hide or disable open-simulator-btn on the trainee profile when consent is revoked/anonymized

MEDIUM: make AdminDashboard provider-drill-N rows actually drill down (navigate to a provider trainee-level list using ?provider_id=) so the aggregation-only + drill-down story is demonstrable in the UI
LOW: throttle/group 'accessed' consent logs (or collapse them in the audit trail UI); drop `_id` from consent-logs items; fix the <span> inside <option> React warning
critical_code_review_comments: create_employment() checks only the wage_data scope; it never checks consent.given, so a revoked/anonymized trainee can still accumulate outcome records - the privacy claim 'revoke stops collection' is not backed by code.
schedule_followups() has no consent filter; certified enrollments of revoked trainees will get new pending follow-ups (contact_for_verification scope ignored).
trainees_overview() calls accessible_trainee_ids() before the 403 guard and then issues 3 sequential per-trainee queries; fine at demo scale but batch with $in if data grows.
get_trainee() writes an audit row on every read with no rate limiting - consent_logs grows unbounded with page loads (241 rows after one QA session vs 187 seeded).
server.py is 1306 lines - consider splitting into routers (trainees/consent, analytics/export, ml) before it crosses the maintainability threshold.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Enroll modal: the main 'consent-checkbox' is UNCHECKED by default and enroll-submit-btn is disabled until you check it - always .check() it (this is intended informed-consent UX, not a bug). Scope checkboxes are consent-scope-{employment_status|wage_data|contact_for_verification}, all checked by default. Simulator wage testids are whatsapp-wage-<10k / 10-15k / 15-25k / 25k+ and require clicking whatsapp-quick-reply-employed first. To open a profile from the provider table, click the first <td> of the row containing the trainee name. window.confirm is used for revoke - register page.on('dialog', accept) BEFORE clicking revoke-consent-btn. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope: exact-count assertions across modules race with the QA trainees created by test_phase7_privacy (already made tolerant); use -n 0 when in doubt. Clear db.login_attempts before re-running test_auth_lockout.
rca_of_the_issue: Scope enforcement was implemented only at the wage sink (create_employment/compute_summary/_export_rows/wage_progression check the 'wage_data' scope), but no write path checks consent.given or the employment_status/contact_for_verification scopes. revoke_and_anonymize() therefore rewrites PII and clears consent, yet subsequent POST /api/employment (reachable from the still-visible Simulator button) succeeds and creates fresh outcome records for a withdrawn trainee. Fix centrally: a helper assert_consent(trainee, scope) called from create_employment, create_non_placement, respond_followup and schedule_followups, plus a UI guard on open-simulator-btn.
